description: Advisory completeness checks for the published 00px /pixel/{token}/e.gif installation template. The opaque token has no inferred encoding or length requirement, and the optional cachebuster is checked only for the exact installation stub. The reported /tracking/ and /vast/pixel/ video trackers remain outside this pack.

params.name: creative_token
params.description: The published counting-pixel template carries an opaque generated token in this path segment. This warning identifies an empty template slot and does not assert an undocumented collector API requirement.
params.fix_hint: Keep the token from the generated 00px counting-pixel tag.

params.name: t
params.description: The published example uses this query field for a cachebuster. Its presence, emptiness, encoding and numeric format are not declared mandatory by the guide.

rules.message: The 00px counting pixel still contains the cachebuster installation stub from the published example.
rules.fix_hint: Replace INSERIR+CACHEBUSTER with a cachebuster value or a macro expanded by the serving platform.
